region.name: Manipur
region.visitors_note: Yearly visitor counts published by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board, 2021–2025. 2021 was a Covid year. Counts are the board's own, from hotel and site registers; they aren't comparable to census-style surveys.
region.travel_note: Manipur has seen ethnic violence since May 2023. Movement between the Imphal valley and the hill districts can be restricted, and curfews and internet shutdowns have been imposed at short notice. Check the state government's and your own government's current advisories before travelling; the circuits and drive times here assume open roads and are not travel advice. Indian visitors from other states need an Inner Line Permit.
